description:
About our brand and products:Hahaha is a premium kids streetwear brand, 100% made in Los Angeles from GOTS-certified organic cotton (Transaction Certificate #GOTS-CUC-03-TC-1033552). Every garment is OEKO-TEX Standard 100 certified, meaning it's tested for 350+ harmful substances and safe for direct skin contact. We sell customizable hoodies, tees, zip-up jackets, joggers, shorts, and beanies for kids ages 3-12. Garments retail from $50 to $122. Each customizable piece features a hook-and-loop panel on the chest where kids attach and swap embroidered patches. We carry 29 patch collections (around 145 unique designs) sold in packs of 5-6, priced $15 to $22 per pack. The collections span cultural heritage, seasonal themes, and characters.

What makes us different:We started Hahaha because we were tired of buying five character tees just to survive the week. So we built something different: one garment with an interchangeable patch system. New day, new patch, same jacket. Kids get self-expression. Parents get fewer clothes to buy, wash, and store. That alone makes this an easy story to tell. But what really sets us apart is the safety standard. Most brands say "organic cotton" and leave it there. GOTS certification means the entire supply chain, from seed to finished garment, is independently audited. No toxic dyes, no formaldehyde, no greenwashing. Add OEKO-TEX Standard 100 testing and full Los Angeles manufacturing, and you have a product parents can feel genuinely confident about. Our patch collections also carry real meaning. We produce American Spirit, Native American, Chinese heritage, Mexican/Day of the Dead, Indian heritage, and Armenian heritage collections, along with seasonal, art world (Van Gogh, da Vinci), and lifestyle themes. Families see themselves in this brand.

How affiliates can earn:You earn a percentage commission on every sale made through your unique affiliate link or coupon code. Every garment purchase naturally leads to patch add-ons, and patch collectors come back for new collections. This means repeat purchases are built into the product, not forced through discounts. Average order values trend higher because of bundling (garment + patches). Top-performing affiliates may be invited to our Ambassador tier with increased commission rates and early access to new drops.

How to promote us:This brand sells best through authentic, parent-to-parent storytelling. If you have kids, show them swapping patches. If you cover parenting, sustainability, or kids' fashion, talk about why GOTS certification matters (most parents don't know the difference between "organic" and GOTS-certified). Content angles that work: "one hoodie, five looks" outfit videos, patch swap reels, unboxing patch collection packs, "what's actually in your kid's clothes" educational posts, and cultural heritage spotlights. We provide affiliate links and coupon codes. Our best-performing content comes from creators who educate their audience on textile safety while showing the fun side of the product.

Other information:Hahaha ships from Los Angeles. Free shipping on orders over $175. We offer exchanges within 14 days (currently no returns). Our website is hahaha.la and our Instagram is @hahaha.dtla. We are a growing brand with a loyal early customer base, so affiliates joining now are getting in at the ground floor before wider retail distribution.
